offers.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
offers.description:
About the Role

We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist who is not just a recruiter—but a strategic hiring partner. This role is tailor-made for someone who thrives in fast-paced, high-growth startup environments, understands the nuances of tech hiring, and can work seamlessly under tight deadlines and high expectations.
offers.requirements:
Key Responsibilities

🔹 Technical Recruitment (Primary Focus – 80%)

  • Own end-to-end recruitment for all tech roles including Backend, Frontend, DevOps, QA, Product, and Data etc

offers.title: Front-end Engineer/Web Developer (SDE 1 & 2)
offers.description:
• Build, design and code new features and enhancements for Web Applications.

  • Build cross browser and cross device compatible web applications.

  • Participate in software architecture, design discussions and code reviews.

  • Thorough understanding of JavaScript, its quirks, and workarounds.

  • Unit-test code for robustness, including edge cases, usability, and general reliability.
offers.requirements:
• BE/B Tech from 4 year college or university.

  • Strong in problem solving, data structures and algorithm design.

  • Proficient understanding of web markup, including HTML5, CSS3 and Responsive Web Design

offers.title: iOS Developer
offers.description:
• Design and build advanced applications for the iOS platform

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.

  • Implement MVVM architecture for scalable and maintainable code.

  • Write
offers.requirements:
• 2-4 years of experience in developing enterprise-class mobile apps for iOS. 

  • Experience in shipping iOS apps and proven work on at least one published app.
